subject: DPA audit rights & Art.28/30 evidence request - GreenBank
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenbank.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: GreenBank Privacy Team <privacy@greenbank.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: DPA audit rights & Art.28/30 evidence request

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this — GreenBank is progressing through our onboarding checklist and our legal team has a couple of follow-ups related to the DPA and audit rights. We need to collect the following artifacts so we can complete our internal DPIA sign-off and satisfy the regulator review: 

- A current list of subprocessors, including last-onboarded date and country of processing (CSV or spreadsheet).
- An excerpt of your Article 30 register or an export of processing activities scoped to our account (PII/redaction acceptable).
- Evidence of KMS wrap/wrapping keys (attestation text or diagram + contact for KMS provider).
- Sample ledger/trace showing cross-border transfers for the last 90 days (redacted is OK).
- SOC 2 report summary and most recent penetration test date (high level).
- Confirmation of audit rights procedure and contact for scheduling a DPIA walkthrough.

We're attaching a short scope matrix to show items we need by category (attached: GreenBank_Audit_Scope.xlsx). Our preferred timeframe is two weeks for a first deliverable (by 2027-05-02); if there are blockers, please flag now.

If there's anything that requires a legal redline (e.g., audit rights, onshore-only export), call that out so we can route to contracting.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Privacy Counsel | GreenBank
elena.ruiz@greenbank.com

Attachment: GreenBank_Audit_Scope.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenbank.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 17:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPA audit rights & Art.28/30 evidence request

Elena —

Thanks for the clear scope. We can support the items you listed; summary and next steps below. Attaching the DPA addendum draft and our current subprocessors export for immediate review.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Addendum_v1.pdf; redwood_subprocessors_20270418.csv

Scope & proposed first deliverable (target 2027-05-02):
- Subprocessor CSV with onboarding dates and processing locations (attached).
- Art.30 register excerpt scoped to GreenBank (we will produce a redacted export and an appendix if needed).
- KMS attestation: short-form attestation included in the addendum; full diagrams available on request.
- Ledger sample: we'll provide a 90-day redacted transfer trace (S3/Drive link to follow).
- SOC2 / pen test: we'll provide a report summary and the date of last penetration test.
- DPIA walkthrough: propose a 60-minute session in week of 2027-05-03.

Open items for us: clarify whether GreenBank requires an unredacted Art.30 ledger or a redacted extract (redaction is standard unless a non-redaction NDA is in place). Also confirm whether you need a signed DPA addendum (DocuSign) or the draft is sufficient for now.

I'll loop in Lauren to help with export logistics and Priyom for the DPIA/controls attestation. We will upload the artifacts to a shared Drive folder and send links once the first bundle is ready.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: Redwood_DPA_Addendum_v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB); redwood_subprocessors_20270418.csv (CSV, 9KB)

---
Note: internal roadmap — prepare redacted Art.30 export, confirm KMS attestation text with infra, schedule DPIA walk-through

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: DPA audit rights & Art.28/30 evidence request / internal questions

Grace / Priyom — quick internal notes before we send the ledger extract and upload: 

1) Art.30 export: GreenBank asked for an "excerpt of your Article 30 register or an export of processing activities scoped to our account". I recommend we provide:
   - a redacted Art.30 CSV (remove unrelated account ids, anonymize internal operator IDs)
   - a short mapping doc that explains fields and retention periods.

2) KMS attestation: Priyom, can you confirm whether the KMS diagram + attestation text we have for Dedicated customers is suitable for GreenBank (they are explicit about KMS wrap). If not, we may need a minor addendum.

3) Transfer trace: provide a 90-day transfer sample but limit to metadata (timestamp, source region, destination region, model id). Avoid user-level tokens.

4) Governance / Audit rights: if GreenBank insists on onshore-only export, we should flag potential contractual implications and involve legal.

Proposed owner breakdown: I will own Art.30 export and Drive upload; Grace to finalize DPA addendum; Priyom to confirm KMS attestation text.

Will draft the upload package tonight and share the Drive link.

-Lauren
Director, Privacy Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Quoted: "We're attaching a short scope matrix... Our preferred timeframe is two weeks..." — Elena

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenbank.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: GreenBank Privacy Team <privacy@greenbank.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPA audit rights & Art.28/30 evidence request

Hi Grace / Lauren,

Thank you — that approach sounds good. A few clarifications and next steps from our side: 

- We prefer a redacted Art.30 export for now; however, our internal auditors may request an unredacted ledger under an NDA during the regulator review — we will let you know if that becomes necessary.
- Please provide the draft DPA addendum via DocuSign when convenient; signatories will be our Head of Procurement and Head of Compliance.
- For the DPIA walkthrough, 2027-05-04 or 2027-05-05 between 14:00-16:00 CET would work for our team.
- Can you also include a short retention policy excerpt (one page) and the date of the last SOC2 audit?

We have attached an updated scope spreadsheet for clarity. If you can confirm the Drive link and DocuSign timeline by EOD tomorrow, we will flag any redlines quickly.

Best regards,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Privacy Counsel | GreenBank
elena.ruiz@greenbank.com

Attachment: GreenBank_Audit_Scope.xlsx (updated v2, 8KB)

Next actions: Redwood to upload artifacts to shared Drive (link requested), send DocuSign for DPA addendum, confirm DPIA walkthrough time.
